collider.pdp: Delivery cut-off ('Order within X to get delivery by Tuesday') + what's-in-the-box list. Copy for live-fish shipping days.
collider.pdp-details: Us vs Them comparison grid - use for 'our live-arrival guarantee vs local pet shop'.

bloom.pdp: Round image swatches tagged NEW + Single/2/3 Pack chips + subscribe & save cards -> guppy strain swatches + Pair/Trio/Group of 6 chips.

people4ocean.product-card: Sold Out / Coming Soon states inline with one-tap add - use for strains/batches that come and go.

giordanos.bundle-builder: Bundle builder on an Impact-theme build (Electric Eye).

brooklinen.bundle-builder: Build-your-bundle with compare + review proof (desktop + mobile combined).

metabu.hero: Headless rebuild by Acqurio Tech; AI shade-finder quiz + try-on live on site.

nasher-miles.hero: Single bold promise ('Every trip needs a co-pilot') + category tiles (Handbags/Sets/Backpacks/Accessories) above the banner on mobile so shoppers pick a lane in one tap. Guppy store: tiles for Guppy pairs / Trios / Starter kits / Food & care above a hero promising 'Live arrival guaranteed'.
nasher-miles.header: Compact mobile header with search, account and cart always visible plus a 'New' badge on the hot nav item. Use a 'New strain' badge on the nav link to your latest guppy drop.
nasher-miles.product-card: Cards with a % off flag and clean cut-out images on white; 'New Arrivals / Best Sellers' toggle above the grid. For fish: 'Best sellers' vs 'New strains' toggle, and a 'Pair'/'Trio' flag on each card.
nasher-miles.pdp: Dimensions diagram as the 2nd image, colour swatches, big orange ADD TO CART and a 4-icon trust strip (free shipping, quality-tested, hassle-free returns, support). For guppies: 2nd image = adult size/colour diagram (male vs female), trust strip = Live-arrival guarantee / Insulated packing / Ships Mon-Wed / WhatsApp support.
nasher-miles.pdp-details: Annotated lifestyle images (callouts like 'Water resistant', 'Easy grab handles') explain features without walls of text. Annotate a tank photo: 'tail type', 'adult size 3-4 cm', 'temp 24-28°C', 'community-safe'.
nasher-miles.sticky-atc: Sticky bottom bar shows Total + MRP strike + '72% off' chip + '7-day returns, no questions asked' right next to ADD TO CART - the risk reversal sits at the moment of decision. Put 'DOA? Free replacement - photo within 2 hrs' in the same spot.
nasher-miles.footer: Newsletter footer 'Check out of Reality' with one email field. For a fish store: 'Get new-strain drops & shipping-day alerts' signup.

juicy-chemistry.bundle-builder: 'Complete Your Routine' 3-step bundle on the PDP: numbered steps (Exfoliate > Moisturise > Protect), each pre-'ADDED' with its own rating, per-item savings and one ADD TO CART with the total. Lifts AOV because the routine framing makes the add-ons feel necessary. Guppy store: 'Complete your setup' = 1 Acclimate (water conditioner) > 2 Feed (guppy food) > 3 Thrive (guppy trio), pre-ticked, one button with the bundle total.
juicy-chemistry.pdp: Image-led PDP with certification badges (Ecocert, in-vivo tested) and quantified claims on the first image; size chips with price and % off in each chip. For fish: put 'Live arrival guaranteed' + 'Bred in India, quarantined 14 days' badges on the first photo and pair/trio chips with per-fish price.
juicy-chemistry.pdp-details: Ratings count + clinical claim + size selector + qty stepper above ADD TO CART, with 'Pairs well with' cross-sells below. Use 'Pairs well with' for food, breeder box and plants under each strain.
juicy-chemistry.hero: Promo/collab hero with a coupon code in the banner and a persistent offer announcement bar (Buy 3 for 999). Use the bar for the shipping cut-off: 'Order by 12 pm Mon-Wed - ships same day'.
juicy-chemistry.header: Red offer bar + centered logo + mega nav by concern ('Shop by concern', 'Curated rituals'). Fish equivalent: shop by tank size / beginner-friendly / strain.
juicy-chemistry.product-card: Bestseller cards with 'Save x%' flags, star ratings and review counts visible on mobile. Show ratings + 'Live arrival guaranteed' microcopy on each guppy card.
juicy-chemistry.reviews: Rating histogram, 'Write a review / Ask a question' buttons and an AI 'Customers say' summary on top of 10k+ reviews. A summary like 'Customers say: fish arrived healthy, colours as shown' is strong social proof for live animals.

eternal-blue.hero: Full-bleed editorial portrait with one line ('Time-tested botanical knowledge adapted for modern haircare') and a single 'Explore' link - calm, premium, no clutter. For guppies: full-bleed macro shot of a tail in a blue tank with one line about your breeding story.
eternal-blue.header: Minimal transparent header (logo, Cart count, Menu) that floats over imagery. Good for a premium strain-focused store where the fish photos sell.
eternal-blue.pdp: Product on a sky-blue backdrop, short benefit copy, 'free-from' chips (Sulphate-free, Phthalate-free...) and one full-width Add to Cart with the price in the button. Swap chips for 'Tank-bred / Quarantined / Medication-free'.
eternal-blue.pdp-details: Independent results stat ('87.5% of participants rated the products effective') right under the CTA, then expandable Ingredients with a photo per ingredient. For fish: a stat like '98% arrive alive (last 500 orders)' under the button, then expandable Care sheet (temp, pH, diet, tank mates).
eternal-blue.reviews: Clean review wall with photo UGC and a 'Rated 5.0 stars' header + Leave a review button. Ask buyers for unboxing/tank photos - live fish UGC is the strongest proof of healthy arrival.

snitch.pdp: Headless Shopify PDP: model image gallery, colour thumbnails as images, size buttons, black ADD + bag/wishlist/share icons. Use image swatches for each guppy strain variant (male/female/pair).
snitch.pdp-details: Offer chip ('Enjoy 10% off on next order above 5990'), size guide, 'FREE 1-2 day delivery on 5k+ pincodes' and a pincode CHECK for delivery date before ADD. For live fish, a pincode checker that says 'Ships Mon, arrives Wed - live-arrival covered' removes the biggest worry.
snitch.sticky-atc: Mobile sticky black ADD bar stays at the bottom even inside 'You may also like' - add-to-cart is never more than a thumb away.

mokobara.pdp: Colors / Compare tabs on the swatches, an EMI offer strip, Pay in full vs Pay in 4 pricing, and a delivery date plus pincode check right above ADD TO CART.
mokobara.sticky-atc: Sticky full-width ADD TO CART bar on mobile, with delivery date kept visible.

minimalist.cart-drawer: Tiered reward progress bar in the cart drawer (Extra 5% off at ₹599, 10% at ₹899, then a free gift), coupon field, offer list and GoKwik checkout. Copy it as: free heat pack at ₹X, free food at ₹Y.

whole-truth.pdp: 'Select pack size' cards (Box of 6 / 12) with a per-unit price and savings tag, then a pincode delivery check. Pair / Trio / Group cards would work the same way.
whole-truth.pdp-details: Full ingredient list as a % table: radical transparency.

subko.pdp-details: 'Flavour Meter' table rating each attribute on a scale, plus 'Best Brewed With' icons. Turn it into a care meter (temperament, difficulty, tank size) per strain.
subko.sticky-atc: 'Flavour Meter' table rating each attribute on a scale, plus 'Best Brewed With' icons. Turn it into a care meter (temperament, difficulty, tank size) per strain.

blue-tokai.variant-selector: Grind selector chips (French Press, Aeropress…) with roast info.
blue-tokai.pdp: Grind + pack options, an AI coffee-assistant bubble and a pincode check.

sleepy-owl.variant-selector: Round image swatches for brew method / grind.
sleepy-owl.cart-drawer: Cart drawer with mug upsell carousel and a coupon nudge.

koparo.product-card: Large 'Save NN%' callouts on every card.
koparo.variant-selector: Size chips (1L / 3L / 5L) with savings on the larger refills.

bare-necessities.pdp: Starter pack vs refill pack architecture, with a 'how to refill your forever case' accordion.

bummer.variant-selector: Colour swatches plus a size chart link, in loud Gen-Z colours.

supertails.hero: Indian pet-care store built by Dynamic Dreamz: the closest reference for a fish/pet shop.

huft.pdp: Pack-of-1/5/7 tier cards with unit price + % off, flavor swatches, Human-Grade trust pills, coupon box and pincode delivery. Copy for guppy pack sizes + live-arrival guarantee + shipping check.
huft.pdp-details: Benefit/ingredient storytelling below buy box — use for care sheet / water-param trust on live fish.
huft.sticky-atc: Mobile sticky ATC with Watch & Buy video — keep fish unboxing or arrival clips near ATC.
huft.product-card: Pet category cards with ratings and offer badges.
huft.reviews: Dense review block with photos — social proof for live-arrival claims.

nykd.pdp: Colour swatches + dual ATC / Buy Now. Size-gated ATC is the caution; Bra Advisor quiz (Seventh Triangle) is the standout education pattern for 'which fish for my tank'.
nykd.variant-selector: Colour swatches with clear selected state.

arata.pdp: Pack of 1/2/3 cards with MOST POPULAR + FREE gift + SAVE + ALMOST GONE scarcity. Direct template for fish multi-packs / starter kits.
arata.product-card: Bestsellers filters + category tiles on homepage.

ranavat.cart-drawer: Free-shipping/gift progress bar + Complete Your Ritual checkbox upsells + gift note. Copy for aquarium starter-kit AOV and free-shipping thresholds.
ranavat.pdp: Size toggles, Subscribe & Save, Shop Pay, UGC strip under buy box.

renee.cart-drawer: Reward-tier progress bar (free shipping, gifts, % off) pulls order value up; mirror with free live-arrival shipping tiers for fish packs.

katkare.hero: Vet-led trust hero (Doc Polly) + free-shipping announcement. Mirror with aquarist/expert endorsement for live-fish arrivals.
katkare.product-card: Rounded cards with star ratings + unit price (€/L) under pack price — copy for guppy pack cards (₹/fish or ₹/pair).
katkare.pdp: Health-indicator litter PDP: benefit bullets with icons, unit pricing, multi-pack chips with % off. Strong template for fish pack tiers and live-arrival trust copy.
katkare.variant-selector: Pack quantity chips (1–4) with discount badges; subscription vs one-time delivery toggle nearby.
katkare.cart-drawer: Post-ATC confirm modal with subscription cadence ('Lieferung alle 4 Wochen') + checkout CTA. Recurring-delivery pattern for fish food/care add-ons.
katkare.sticky-atc: Mobile sticky ATC on pet PDP.
katkare.reviews: Review strip under buy box builds pet-care trust.

alpine-apothecary.hero: Calm cream/seriffed wellness brand; pain-point headline cards.
alpine-apothecary.product-card: Two large story cards with question headlines ('Can't sleep?'), star ratings, price, full-width CTA — good for curated fish collections with benefit-first copy.
alpine-apothecary.pdp: Trust-led PDP: benefit pills, inline testimonial, clinical social-proof bar, pack options with ₹/night unit pricing. Calm storytelling for premium fish lines.
alpine-apothecary.variant-selector: Starter vs Reset pack cards with per-unit breakdown.
alpine-apothecary.cart-drawer: Clean cream cart drawer with qty stepper and WhatsApp/email help link — low-friction assist before checkout.
alpine-apothecary.sticky-atc: Mobile sticky bar with price + ATC.

rare-rabbit.hero: Premium fashion hero; study for high-end photography + minimal chrome.
rare-rabbit.product-card: Dense fashion grid with hover/quick actions; useful for pack/colour browsing patterns.
rare-rabbit.pdp: 2×2 image grid + sticky buy column, colour swatches, size chips with Notify Me on OOS, PIN delivery check. Size/colour UX transferable to fish colour morph / pack selection.
rare-rabbit.variant-selector: Fabric swatches + size boxes with clear OOS strike-through and Notify Me.
rare-rabbit.sticky-atc: Mobile sticky ATC on fashion PDP.

itokri.header: Dense double-row category nav + 'Search 100,000+' — category IA ideas for fish species/collections.
itokri.product-card: Story-led cards with craft labels and per-metre unit pricing; adapt for curated fish collections and origin tags.
itokri.pdp: Craft badges, scarcity meter ('Only X available'), length selector, free-shipping cue — scarcity + unit measure patterns for limited guppy drops.
itokri.cart-drawer: Free-shipping progress bar, Trustpilot badge, gift-wrap upsell, secure-payment strip. Strong AOV levers for fish packs + free live-arrival shipping thresholds.
itokri.reviews: Excellent 4.7 / 14k reviews carousel with Verified Customer — social proof for live-arrival guarantees.

sri-sri-tattva.hero: Offer-led festive banner carousel ('Flat 10% off', '₹100 off on entire range') above category tiles. For a guppy store: rotate a seasonal offer banner (e.g. breeding-pair deal) directly above species tiles.
sri-sri-tattva.category-tiles: Big pastel category tiles with product photography (Ghee, Oral Care, Juices…). Map to fish categories: Guppies, Bettas, Shrimp, Plants, Food, Equipment.
sri-sri-tattva.product-card: Dense cards: star rating + review count, size line (500 ml / 1 L), MRP strike-through, % OFF corner badge, 'Sold Out' pill and a one-tap ADD button. Copy for fish cards: '(4.8) 120 reviews', 'Pair / Trio / 5 pcs', ₹ strike price, ADD.
sri-sri-tattva.delivery-check: Pincode serviceability prompt on the homepage ('Enter Delivery Pincode → Check serviceability'). Critical for live fish: check pincode first, then show live-arrival delivery ETA / whether overnight courier serves the area.
sri-sri-tattva.pdp: Clean PDP: rating + review count under title, MRP 'Inclusive of all taxes', qty stepper + full-width ADD TO CART pinned at bottom on mobile.
sri-sri-tattva.pdp-details: Four trust icons under price (Free delivery above ₹999, customer support hours, quality testing, secure payment). Swap in: live-arrival guarantee, expert support hours, quarantined stock, secure payment.
sri-sri-tattva.reviews: Rating summary (4.8, 95 reviews) with Write-a-review, filter/sort icons and 'Verified' badges on each review.
sri-sri-tattva.sticky-atc: Mobile sticky qty + ADD TO CART bar sitting above the app-style bottom nav, with 'Similar Products' carousel cards that each have their own ADD.
sri-sri-tattva.header: App-download strip ('Order faster with our app') + prominent search with rotating placeholder ('Search for Honey').
sri-sri-tattva.footer: Navy footer with policies (shipping, cancellation), social links and app-store badges.

eleven-eleven.hero: Full-bleed editorial video/image hero ('The Guest List') with a short story paragraph and MEN / WOMEN text links. Calm, premium storytelling — for fish, a slow aquarium video hero with one line of story.
eleven-eleven.header: Rotating announcement bar ('Autumn Winter 2026: now live') + centered logo, minimal nav.
eleven-eleven.product-card: Minimal image-first product grid with lots of whitespace — lets photography carry the sale. Works for high-quality guppy strain photos.
eleven-eleven.pdp: Image-led PDP with thumbnail rail; price 'MRP incl. of all taxes', size dropdown + View Size Guide, ADD TO CART plus 'MEET THE MAKERS'.
eleven-eleven.pdp-details: Provenance copy under the buy box: 'Meticulously crafted by 7 artisans in 9.17 hours'. Equivalent for fish: 'Bred in-house by X over Y weeks, quarantined 14 days' — concrete numbers build trust.
eleven-eleven.variant-selector: Simple size dropdown with View Size Guide link right above it — for fish, a 'Pair / Trio / Group' selector with a 'sexing & sizing guide' link.
eleven-eleven.sticky-atc: Full-width black sticky ADD TO CART on mobile; accordions for Wash care, Shipment & delivery, Returns & exchange — mirror with Acclimatisation, Live-arrival shipping, DOA policy.
eleven-eleven.cart-drawer: Clean side cart with qty stepper, order note, 'Taxes and shipping calculated at checkout' and a one-tap BUY NOW (express checkout with UPI badges).

nish-hair.hero: Campaign hero carousel with a collab line (Evil Eye x Nish Hair) and single SHOP NOW; floating WhatsApp/call button and INR currency switcher.
nish-hair.header: Centered logo, mega nav (Shop Categories, Shop For Men, Jewellery, Bridal), cart count.
nish-hair.product-card: Lifestyle-photo cards with ADD TO CART on the image and teal price — quick add without opening the PDP.
nish-hair.pdp: Considered-purchase PDP: model photo grid, star rating with review count, 'Pay later / ₹537 per month' EMI box.
nish-hair.pdp-details: Buy box stacks qty + Add to cart, 'REQUEST A VIDEO CALL' and Razorpay Buy Now; no-return note for discounted items. For fish: a 'Request a live video of your fish' button is a strong trust lever for high-value strains.
nish-hair.reviews: Rating breakdown bars (4.8 from 48 reviews) + customer photo reviews grid with Write-a-review — photo UGC of fish in customers' tanks would do the same.
nish-hair.sticky-atc: Mobile sticky product bar with thumbnail, name, price and + button, plus 'Explore the world of Hair' quick-add carousel.

neater-pets.hero: Problem-solution hero ('Neater Feeder — food stays on top, water flows to bottom') with inset product-feature circle and free-shipping-over-$40 announcement bar.
neater-pets.header: Free-shipping threshold bar, search with rotating product placeholder, emoji pet nav (Dogs 🐶, Cats 🐱) — try 'Guppies 🐟, Shrimp 🦐, Plants 🌿'.
neater-pets.product-card: Collection cards with star rating + big review counts (590, 1006), colour swatch dots with '+3', 'From $29.99' pricing and 'Up to 27% off / New arrival' badges.
neater-pets.pdp: Pet PDP with strike price, Shop Pay instalments line, colour swatches and Package Count chips (1/2/3).
neater-pets.pdp-details: Feature bullets + accordions (How to use, Cleaning instructions, Country of origin) beside a compact buy box.
neater-pets.variant-selector: Image colour swatches + Package Count pill chips — reuse as Strain swatches + Pair/Trio/5-pack chips.
neater-pets.sticky-atc: 'You may also like' card with inline size dropdown and its own ADD TO CART — cross-sell without leaving the PDP (fish food / heater add-on).
neater-pets.cart-drawer: Cart drawer with free-shipping progress bar ('Spend $27.01 more for free shipping!'), CHECKOUT total button and Shop Pay / PayPal / GPay express buttons. Ideal pattern for raising AOV on fish orders.

royce-india.hero: Mobile hero leads with city launch + 'Same-day delivery now available' and round category circles (Diwali Hampers, Nama, Wafers…). For guppies: 'Same-day delivery in Bengaluru' / 'Live-arrival guarantee' as the hero line, with strain circles (Endler, Moscow, Koi, Dumbo Ear).
royce-india.header: Clean logo-centred mobile header + app-style bottom tab bar (Home, Gifting, Menu, Favourite, WhatsApp) — a WhatsApp tab is ideal for 'ask before you buy live fish' questions.
royce-india.product-card: Large photo cards with name, price and a full-width Add to cart on every card — one-tap add for fish food, pairs and starter kits from the collection grid.
royce-india.pdp: Perishable PDP: veg mark, price incl. taxes, stacked Add to cart + Buy Now (express) buttons. Copy the dual-CTA for guppy pairs so impulse buyers skip the cart.
royce-india.pdp-details: Spec list (net quantity, pieces, weight, shelf life, box size) — reuse as Fish specs: sex/pair, size at dispatch, age, water parameters, packing (bag + oxygen + heat pack).
royce-india.cross-sell: 'Similar Products' row with Add to cart under each card directly below the buy box — show 'Other strains' or 'Pairs well with: food, net, breeder box'.
royce-india.sticky-atc: Sticky Add to cart + Buy Now pinned on mobile even in the footer — keeps the CTA reachable on long fish-care PDPs.
royce-india.cart-drawer: Minimal drawer: qty stepper, subtotal, single 'Proceed' CTA and 'shipping, taxes and discounts at checkout' — low-friction; add a delivery-date line for live shipments.

the-summerhouse.hero: Full-bleed editorial hero with a short poetic line ('Slow craft for fast nights') and one NEW CTA — a calm, premium look for a curated show-line guppy brand.
the-summerhouse.header: Transparent header over the hero, spaced wordmark, wishlist + cart icons; desktop nav shows Collections, New, The Journal (care guides) — a 'Fish care journal' link builds trust.
the-summerhouse.product-card: Minimal cards: big photo, name, price, no clutter — works for high-quality fish photography where the fish is the hero.
the-summerhouse.pdp: Breadcrumb with Previous / Next product arrows, image gallery and a sticky name + price + ADD TO CART bar — Prev/Next lets buyers flip through strains quickly.
the-summerhouse.pdp-details: Colour swatches, size chips with out-of-stock strike-through (M), 'Size guide' and 'Ask us on WhatsApp' next to the selector, then Description / Shipping & Returns / Size and fit accordions — mirror as Strain swatches, Pair/Trio chips with sold-out strike, 'Ask on WhatsApp' and Shipping & Live Arrival accordion.
the-summerhouse.variant-selector: Round colour swatches + text size chips with crossed-out sold-out size — clear stock status per variant (e.g. sold-out female-only option).
the-summerhouse.sticky-atc: 'Complete The Look' carousel under the PDP while the name/price/ADD TO CART bar stays pinned — 'Complete your tank' (plants, food, heater) cross-sell.

paw-labs.hero: Split hero with 'Trusted by pet parents' / 'The latest research, science backed' claims and a vet-themed dog image — trust-first opener; for fish use 'Bred in-house, quarantined 14 days'.
paw-labs.header: Orange promo bar ('Veterans Day Sale: extra 15% off code TAKE15') + orange 'Shop Now' header button — high-contrast urgency banner for festival sales (Diwali, 11.11).
paw-labs.pdp: Buy box with 1 / 3 / 5 Pack chips, 'Buy 2 Get 1 Free' burst on the pack shot, strike price and ingredient table — use pack chips for 1 pair / 3 pairs / colony with a 'Free male' burst.
paw-labs.pdp-details: Mobile: ingredient table with dotted leaders, -33% off strike price and big rounded ADD TO CART, then 'as featured in' press band. Desktop: 'Why Wild Alaskan Salmon Oil is different?' long-form story — 'Why our guppies are different?' (bloodline, feeding, quarantine).
paw-labs.sticky-atc: Long-form 'Our Vet Precision Formula' copy block with small floating 'Get 15% Off' tab instead of a blocking popup — capture emails without hiding the PDP.
paw-labs.cart-drawer: Cart drawer with 'Subscribe & Save 15% OFF' toggle on the line item, Frequently Bought Together (one-tap Add), discount code field, subtotal with strike price, Checkout + View Cart. Strong AOV pattern: subscribe-and-save for fish food, FBT for heater / breeder box.

my-pet-frame.hero: 'Save 30% Today — Create stunning art of your cat' with a framed sample portrait and pink CTA on a paw-print blue background; free UK shipping bar on top.
my-pet-frame.header: Two-tier mobile header: 'Free shipping within the UK' strip + bright sale bar ('Fatherday sales: 30% off and free shipping') above logo, account, search and cart.
my-pet-frame.pdp: Personalised PDP with sale price + rating, big framed portrait mock-up and 'Examples in your drawing style' thumbnails under the image.
my-pet-frame.pdp-details: Desktop: 'More info' accordions (Description, Photo tips, Shipping, FAQ) beside a 'How to order a pet frame' video — add a 'How we pack live fish' video next to Shipping/FAQ.
my-pet-frame.product-configurator: 5-step visual configurator: trust ticks (made in UK, 2-5 day shipping, artwork proof in 24h), step progress 1-5, image tiles for drawing style and number of pets, 'Next step' button. For guppies: a 'Build your tank' / 'Build your colony' wizard (strain → pairs → add plants & food).
my-pet-frame.reviews: 192-review photo wall with customer photos/videos, star ratings and 'Write a review' — encourage buyers to upload tank photos of arrived fish.
my-pet-frame.sticky-atc: Photo tips / Shipping / FAQ accordions plus embedded 'How to order' YouTube video and 'How do we work?' numbered steps — process transparency for a made-to-order product.

bay-window.hero: Full-bleed editorial collection hero ('Ombré in motion — Ortus collection') with a single 'Visit now' CTA and a sticky 'Free consultation!' pill + WhatsApp. For guppies: one hero per strain drop ('Blue Moscow — new batch') with a 'Talk to a breeder' pill.
bay-window.header: Minimal luxury header: Furniture / Lighting / Decor / Inspirations / Sale plus a dark 'FREE CONSULTATION' tab and a store-locator pin icon next to search and cart.
bay-window.pdp: High-ticket PDP: big product photo carousel, price with strikethrough + % off, SKU, 'No cost EMI', 'Talk to our stylist', qty, 'Only 2 units left! Hurry up!', store availability and pincode delivery check before Add to cart.
bay-window.variant-selector: Mobile buy box: price | MRP + 23% off, 'No cost EMI starting from INR 21,817/month', 'Talk to our stylist' button, low-stock line in red and 'Store availability' — swap stylist for 'Ask a fish expert on WhatsApp' and show real tank stock ('Only 6 pairs left').
bay-window.delivery-check: Mobile: 'Check delivery time' pincode field sits right under Add to cart, followed by Key features / Material / Dimensions accordions — show live-fish ETA + 'safe to ship to your city this week' here.
bay-window.cart-drawer: Cart drawer with 'Share cart', 'Enter GST No.', 'Schedule dispatch for a later date' and terms checkbox above a full-width checkout button showing the total. Scheduled dispatch is gold for live fish: let buyers pick a ship date (avoid weekends, heat waves, or when they're travelling).
bay-window.product-card: Mobile bestseller cards with % off badge, name, price and a solid 'Add to cart' button directly on the card, followed by Google review cards.
bay-window.reviews: Google-review carousel (avatar, stars, verified tick, 'Leave a Review') — pull Google Business reviews of your fish farm/shop for instant credibility.

shumee.hero: Festive sale hero ('Flat 25% off sitewide') with 'Joy worth gifting' sticker, directly followed by colourful 'Shop by age' pill buttons (0-1, 1-3, 3-6, 6+ years). For guppies: 'Shop by tank size' or 'Shop by experience (beginner / breeder)' pills.
shumee.header: Orange announcement bar ('Festive sale — 25% off sitewide') + cream header with Shop by categories / Toys by age / Bestsellers / Gifting / New arrivals.
shumee.product-card: Cards with 'On sale' ribbon, rating + review count, benefit line ('Gross motor development | Strength & coordination'), age line, price + % off and full-width Add to cart. Use: 'Hardy | Beginner-friendly | Size 3-4 cm' benefit lines on fish cards.
shumee.pdp: PDP with age chip ('0 Months+ · Newborn development'), benefit links under the title, price + 'Save ₹125' pill, purple benefit chips, 'Delivery between Fri, Nov 13 - Mon, Nov 16', EMI line and 'Why parents love these' section.
shumee.pdp-details: Mobile: price/save pill, benefit chips (Newborn friendly, Travel friendly…), estimated delivery date and Snapmint EMI line, then 'Why parents love…' — copy the delivery-date line for live-arrival windows.
shumee.delivery-check: Estimated delivery-date window ('Delivery between Fri, Nov 13 - Mon, Nov 16') shown automatically above EMI — no pincode needed; for fish, show 'Ships Mon-Wed, arrives in 1-2 days'.
shumee.sticky-atc: Mobile sticky qty stepper + Add to cart bar over a 'More than pictures — a first step into discovering the world' story block.
shumee.cart-drawer: Cart with free-gift progress bar ('Add ₹2,628 for free gift', two gift tiers), coupon field, 'View all offers' and Gokwik checkout with savings shown. Use: 'Add ₹500 more for free fish food' tier.
shumee.free-gift: 'Choose any 1 free gift' list inside the cart with item thumbnails, struck MRP, FREE label and '+Add' buttons — e.g. free Java moss / sample food pack for orders over a threshold.
shumee.brand-story: 'We at Shumee believe that play is 90% child & 10% toy' checklist panel with founder/team photo and 'Read our story', followed by 'Toys by category' photo tiles.
shumee.category-tiles: Mobile 2-column photo tiles (Active play, Learning toys, Pretend play, Puzzles & cards) with kids using products — use photo tiles of fish in planted tanks per strain/category.

swayam.hero: 'New Arrival' bedroom-scene banner with 'Order now', followed by a 4-column trust strip (Free shipping over ₹10,000, Easy returns, Secure payments, Premium fabric) and 'Shop by categories'.
swayam.header: Yellow welcome bar with first-order code (WLCM10) above a long category nav including 'Bulk order' — consider a 'Bulk / breeder orders' link for wholesale fish buyers.
swayam.pdp: Mobile PDP: room photo, long descriptive title, price + strikethrough and yellow '42% OFF' pill.
swayam.variant-selector: Colour pill + size tiles (Double Queen / King fitted / Super King) with 'View size chart', qty stepper, 'Add to cart' + 'Buy it now', and an open 'Product information' spec table (material, colour, pattern, thread count) — mirror as a spec table for fish (strain, size, age, sex, temperament).
swayam.pdp-details: Mobile size tiles, size chart link, Add to cart / Buy it now and spec table accordion.
swayam.cross-sell: 'Related products' row with discount pills under the PDP, then 'Stories from our happy customers' photo carousel.
swayam.reviews: Desktop 'Stories from our happy customers' photo-review carousel with ratings.

beauty-by-bie.hero: 'Grazia award-winning Superpower' hero with award badge, product jar and 'Shop now', a ticker of benefits below and 'Shop bestsellers'.
beauty-by-bie.header: Beige 'Free shipping above ₹1099' bar over a centred logo header.
beauty-by-bie.product-card: Cards with stars, 'From ₹2,199', size chips (50g / 100g / 20g) and Add to cart directly on the card — pick pack size (pair / trio / 6-pack) right on the fish card.
beauty-by-bie.pdp: Benefit headline image ('For every pigmentation concern, one solution'), thumbnails, rating and price.
beauty-by-bie.pdp-details: Mobile: 4.6★ 23 reviews, concern tags (reduces pigmentation · fades dark spots · targets acne marks), size chips, Add to cart, 'Complimentary inclusions' (free serum over ₹3,499, 10% welcome) and 'Science and expertise' accordion.
beauty-by-bie.variant-selector: Clean 30 ml / 10 ml size chips with Add to cart.
beauty-by-bie.sticky-atc: Benefits / How to use / Dr. Dinyar's tip accordions, then '94% noticed a reduction… within 8 weeks' clinical claim with before/after slider and a sticky price + Add to cart bar. Fish equivalent: '98% live-arrival rate over 2,000 shipments'.
beauty-by-bie.reviews: Review summary with star distribution bars, customer photos strip and verified-buyer badges.
beauty-by-bie.cart-drawer: Tiered free-gift progress bar (₹2,400 sample → ₹4,400 → ₹6,900 → ₹9,900) with social proof '352 customers unlocked free gifts today', 'You may also like' carousel with discount badges, 'Extra 5% off on online payments' and 'Checkout now — 5% off on prepaid'. Use prepaid nudges to cut COD risk on live fish.

tropical-oasis.hero: Dark tropical photo hero 'The Vitamin You'll Actually Take' with a 'Find Your Formula' primary CTA and 'Shop Best Sellers' secondary — for guppies: 'Find your perfect strain' quiz CTA next to bestsellers.
tropical-oasis.product-card: Clean bottle cards on a tinted grid with a 'Quick Add' button on every card — fast add for fish food/conditioners without opening the PDP.
tropical-oasis.pdp: Supplement PDP: rating, benefit icons, subscribe vs one-time selector with 'Save up to 25% when you subscribe' banner on mobile.
tropical-oasis.pdp-details: Benefit 2x2 icon grid (Liquid = better absorption, Clean ingredients, Made in the USA) above the buy box — do the same with 'Bred in India', 'Live arrival guarantee', 'Quarantined 14 days'.
tropical-oasis.subscribe-save: Pre-selected 'Subscribe & save' card under a 'GET 25% OFF + FREE SHIPPING' header, sticky bar repeats price + 'Delivery every 1 month'. Use it for fish food, water conditioner and test-kit refills.
tropical-oasis.sticky-atc: Mobile sticky bar with qty stepper and 'ADD TO CART — $29.95', plus FDA/GMP certification badges right below — swap for breeder / quarantine credentials.
tropical-oasis.cart-drawer: Cart drawer: 'Spend $50.04 more for free shipping' bar, line item shows subscription saving, 'Deliver every' dropdown editable in the cart, and a 'Goes great with' carousel. Great for adding food/conditioner to a live-fish order.
tropical-oasis.reviews: 'What our customers say' row of UGC video testimonials with star ratings — short clips of customers' tanks would sell guppies better than text reviews.

rasoi-shop.hero: Festive Diwali-themed store: toran garland graphic under the header, round category icons and promo banners — easy seasonal skin (e.g. monsoon breeding season sale).
rasoi-shop.header: Two announcement bars (festive offer + 'Free Shipping | Made in India | Call <number>'), search-first header with language switcher.
rasoi-shop.pdp: PDP buy box: price + strikethrough + 'SAVE 20%' chip + Free Shipping, Snapmint 'Pay ₹610 now, rest in 0% EMI' box, Add to Cart + Buy it Now, then a dated delivery timeline. Floating 'Chat with us' WhatsApp button.
rasoi-shop.pdp-details: Mobile buy box stacks EMI, qty, Add to Cart, Buy it Now and the 3-step delivery timeline, with an app-style bottom nav (Recipe, Categories, Log in, Chat, Cart).
rasoi-shop.delivery-check: 3-step dated timeline: 'Nov 11 Order Today → Nov 11-13 Order Ready → Nov 14-16 Delivered'. Perfect for live fish: show 'Order today → Packed with oxygen Thu → Arrives Fri-Sat' so buyers know the fish won't sit in transit over a weekend.
rasoi-shop.variant-selector: Big qty stepper + green Add to Cart and full-width Buy it Now on mobile.
rasoi-shop.sticky-atc: Mobile sticky bar with price, strikethrough and a compact 'Add to Cart' above the bottom nav.
rasoi-shop.cart-drawer: Cart drawer with 'You may also like' cards showing SAVE % badges, subtotal, Checkout and a blue 'Pay ₹610 now + 0% EMIs later' button — cross-sell nets/food/air pumps here.
rasoi-shop.reviews: Rating histogram (4.48, 40 reviews) with 'Write a review' and dated text reviews.

amante.hero: Category icon row (Bra, Panties, Nightwear, Activewear) above a festive '70% off' carousel — quick visual navigation; use strain icons (Moscow, Dumbo, Koi, Albino) the same way.
amante.header: Burgundy announcement bar 'Your Everyday Ritual Starts Here', centered logo, wishlist + cart.
amante.pdp: Clean PDP: thumbnail rail, image colour swatches, size chips and pincode check in the buy box.
amante.pdp-details: Mobile: colour shown as photo swatches, 'Select Size To Continue' prompt, Size Guide link and 'Check Delivery Availability / Estimated Delivery Date' pincode field before ATC.
amante.variant-selector: Photo swatches for colour (shows the real product in each colour) + size chips with disabled states — for guppies, photo swatches per colour morph and chips for 'Pair / Trio / 5 females'.
amante.reviews: Simple rating histogram with 'Write a review' and verified-buyer badge.

aayraa-jewels.hero: Editorial "Luxury Collection" banner, with Amazon/Flipkart availability buttons right under the header on mobile — borrowed marketplace trust for a young brand. For fish: "Also on Amazon" or "500+ breeders served" chips.
aayraa-jewels.pdp: Buy box: 4.8 rating with 2000+ reviews, strikethrough price + Sale chip, "313 people are currently looking at this" counter, qty + Add to Cart + Buy it Now, then a boxed key-facts card ("Know Your Jewellery").
aayraa-jewels.pdp-details: Offer countdown ("Offer ends in 05:59:50"), accordion for description / refunds / shipping and a Cash on Delivery strip. A live-fish version: "Ships today if ordered in 05:59" plus a DOA guarantee accordion.
aayraa-jewels.variant-selector: Qty stepper with outlined Add to Cart and solid Buy it Now side by side.
aayraa-jewels.cart-drawer: Slim "Item added to your cart" drawer with thumbnail, View Cart and Checkout — minimal, fast.
aayraa-jewels.sticky-atc: Mobile sticky Add to Cart / Buy it Now pair, WhatsApp float stays visible.
aayraa-jewels.reviews: Star breakdown bars with review count and Write a review button.

tropicfeel.hero: Seasonal "Black Friday Private Sale — up to 50% off" hero with members-only angle and black announcement bar to join.
tropicfeel.pdp: Clean PDP: rating with 4,581 reviews, price, "Or €116 if you sign up for our newsletter" (email capture inside the buy box), size grid.
tropicfeel.pdp-details: Under the size grid: "Free Shipping. Estimated delivery: Fri, Nov 13 - Mon, Nov 16" and "30-day returns & free exchanges", then one-line benefits and accordions. For guppies: dated arrival window + live-arrival guarantee right under the button.
tropicfeel.comparison: "Compare sneakers" module: three models side by side with colour swatches, a one-line use case ("For coastal escapes") and icon ratings for collection, trip type, traction, cushioning, plus a desktop sticky ATC bar. Ideal for comparing guppy strains or tank kits (hardiness, adult size, colour, beginner friendly).
tropicfeel.sticky-atc: Full-width rounded "Select your size" sticky button on mobile.
tropicfeel.header: Black promo bar above a minimal logo/search/cart header.

brilliant-petcare.hero: "Your pet deserves Brilliant health" hero with product on a fjord photo, star rating and "100% Norwegian Salmon Oil — single ingredient, multiple benefits" band.
brilliant-petcare.pdp: Pack chips (Single / Triple Pack), one-time vs "Subscribe and save 25%" radio with a delivery schedule dropdown ("Every month (popular)"), qty + Add to Cart and Link express pay.
brilliant-petcare.pdp-details: Round benefit icons (enhanced appetite, shiny coat, soft paws) under the buy box, then nutrition facts and shipping accordions. A fish-food or water-conditioner subscription could copy this exactly.
brilliant-petcare.reviews: "Look at how other pets are loving their Brilliant" — a tilted collage of review cards with a Buy Now button and "Rated 4.5/5 by 6,319+ happy pet parents".
brilliant-petcare.cart-drawer: Cart page confirms the add, repeats the rating line, and upsells a second product ("Calcium & Collagen, Save 25%") with Add to Cart.
brilliant-petcare.sticky-atc: Mobile sticky bar with price, strikethrough and 25% off chip.

chashma.header: Minimal lowercase serif nav (eyeglasses · sunglasses · contact lenses · accessories · explore) with search, wishlist, cart, account icons. Guppy store: keep 4–5 lowercase category words (guppies · plants · shrimp · tank kits · care) for a calm, premium look.
chashma.mega-menu: Three-column dropdown: Shop by Gender list, Shop by Shapes as pill chips with a tiny frame icon each, Shop by Brand. Icon chips let shoppers pick visually. For guppies: 'Shop by strain' chips with a small fish photo (Moscow Blue, Koi, Dumbo Ear, Albino) + 'Shop by tank size'.
chashma.mobile-nav: Burger opens big pastel image cards per category (face photo on the right) instead of a text list, plus a fixed Log in / Wishlist / Contact bar at the bottom. For a fish store: colour-coded cards per category with a fish/plant cut-out photo, and a WhatsApp/Contact shortcut in the bottom bar.
chashma.hero: Carousel hero leading with a service, not a product: "Introducing AI Lenses – Book Free Demo Today", peeking next slide on desktop. Guppy store: lead with the promise ("Live arrival guaranteed – pan-India overnight shipping") with a single clear CTA.
chashma.category-tiles: "Let's Get Started" – four pastel tiles (Sunglasses, Eyeglasses, Contact Lenses, Accessories) with people cut-outs, 2×2 on mobile. Simple, friendly entry for first-timers. Fish store: 'Start here' tiles – Guppies, Live Plants, Starter Kits, Food & Care.
chashma.product-card: Light-grey card with brand + type eyebrow (CHASHMA · EYEGLASSES), name, price with strike-through, colour dots, badges (OUT OF STOCK, CLIPON, 10% OFF) and a wishlist heart; sold-out cards are greyed. For guppies: eyebrow 'MALE · PAIR · TRIO', colour dots for strain variants, 'Sold out – notify me' greyed card.
chashma.collection: Category banner, product count, single 'All Filters' button and Sort; on mobile a floating All Filters / Sort bar. Clean 4-up grid. Fish store: banner per strain family + floating Filter/Sort bar for colour, sex, price, beginner-friendly.
chashma.search: Opened search shows Popular Searches chips and Popular Categories with thumbnails before typing – zero-state that guides. Guppy store: chips like 'Koi guppy', 'Breeding pair', 'Live plants', 'Starter kit'.
chashma.search-results: Predictive dropdown with Suggestions column + product list with thumbnails and a 'Search for "round"' footer row. Fish store: show strain thumbnails so shoppers recognise the fish by colour instantly.
chashma.pdp: Two-image gallery + compact buy box: price, colour swatch, short description, 'Other available sizes' chip, 'Don't know your size? Find Here' (opens a PD measuring guide) and one primary CTA 'Select lens And Buy' instead of plain Add to cart. For guppies: CTA 'Choose pair & shipping' leading into a small configurator.
chashma.variant-selector: Selected colour label + swatch, then 'Other available sizes' as image chips linking sibling products, and a size-help link right below. Guppy store: 'Selected: Male' + sex/pack chips (single, pair, trio) with photo chips linking to sibling strains.
chashma.product-configurator: Best find: "Select lens And Buy" opens a right-side drawer with a 4-dot stepper. Step 1 power type (With prescription: Single Vision, Bi Focal; Without: Clear 0 INR, Zero Power Blue 1000 INR…), step 2 lens type cards with price, image and +Add (Clear 850, Smart 1050, Pro 1850, Thin Pro 2450). Product thumbnail + running Sub Total + Continue stay pinned at the bottom. For a guppy store: 'Build your order' drawer – step 1 pick fish (pair/trio), step 2 add-ons with prices (heat pack, breathing bag upgrade, starter food), step 3 delivery speed, with the running total pinned.
chashma.delivery-check: 'Check Delivery' pincode field with black Check button and an honest note that delivery times vary for complex lenses. Fish store: pincode check that says 'Overnight live delivery available / not available' plus a note about weather-dependent shipping days.
chashma.pdp-details: Offer coupon cards ('flat 10% off – code HELLO10 – no hidden T&C') above accordions: Frame Dimensions, Frame Details, About Product, Shipping & Returns, Reviews & Ratings. Guppy store: offer card + accordions for Size & age, Water parameters, Care guide, Live arrival policy, Reviews.
chashma.sticky-atc: Mobile sticky bar with wishlist heart + full-width green Add To Cart stays at the bottom while scrolling offers and accordions. Use the same on guppy PDPs so the buy button is always one tap away.
chashma.cross-sell: 'You may also like' 4-up row of similar frames with the same card design, followed by Recently Viewed. For fish: 'Pairs well with' – compatible tank mates, plants or food.
chashma.cart-drawer: Drawer with 'Save For Later' on each line, qty dropdown, 'Apply Coupons – see available offers and cashbacks', 'Add A Giftbox – starting at Rs. 49', coupon field, FREE shipping line, grand total, card logos ('Chashma Secured') and Check out. Fish store: swap Giftbox for 'Add insulated box / heat pack – Rs 49' and show 'Live arrival guaranteed' near the total.
chashma.checkout: Standard Shopify one-page checkout reached without sign-in: contact (email or mobile), delivery with India defaults, order summary with discount field. Keep checkout native and fast; just add a delivery-date note for live fish.
chashma.footer: Dark footer with logo + 'see differently' tagline, social icons and three short link columns (categories, policies incl. Store Locator, About/Contact/Home Try On) over a large brand-mark graphic. Guppy store: add 'Live arrival policy' and 'Care guides' to the policy column.

pee-safe.announcement-bar: Black scrolling marquee repeating one tiered offer in lime: "Free Delivery at ₹399 | Get Freebies at ₹1099". Two thresholds in one line push the order value up before a product is even seen. Guppy store: "Free insulated shipping over ₹999 | Free fish food over ₹1,499". Keep it to one message and repeat it.
pee-safe.header: Desktop header puts the search box first (top-left pill, "What are you looking for ?"), logo in the middle, account + round cart button on the right, and a thin text nav row below (Categories ▾, FURR, Pee Safe Plus, Bulk Order Enquiry…). The burger/search/account/cart layout repeats on mobile. Guppy store: search first works for repeat hobbyists who know the strain name ("Moscow blue"); add a "Bulk / breeder enquiry" link like their Bulk Order Enquiry.
pee-safe.mega-menu: Categories ▾ opens a clean 5-column text mega menu (Menstrual Care, Intimate Care, Toilet Hygiene, Sexual Wellness, Gifting – For Him/Her/Unisex) over the hero. Plain text, no images, quick to scan. Fish store: Guppies by strain · Live plants · Shrimp & snails · Tank kits · Food & care · Gifting.
pee-safe.mobile-nav: Burger opens a drawer with a promo banner at the top ("Pick any 2 @ ₹399 – Shop now"), then icon rows (Categories ›, FURR, Pee Safe Plus, Careers, About Us ›, Bulk Order Enquiry) and social icons. The offer takes the first spot in the menu. Guppy store: put the live bundle ("Any 3 pairs @ ₹999") at the top of the burger menu.
pee-safe.search: An empty search already shows best-seller product cards with rating, benefit chips, price and an Add to Cart button, so people can buy without typing. Fish store: show the 4 best-selling strains and a starter kit as soon as search opens.
pee-safe.search-results: Typing "sanitizer" shows suggestion chips (toilet seat sanitizer, sanitizer spray…) above product cards that each have a full Add to Cart button, plus a View All button. You can add to cart straight from search. Guppy store: chips like "koi guppy", "breeding pair", "guppy food", with Add to cart on each fish card.
pee-safe.hero: Big lifestyle campaign slide with a bold headline ("In Your Comfort Zone, Nothing is TOO MUCH"), a product pack shot with a 'Made for heavy flow' badge, a pill CTA, and a floating 'Pee Safe Plus' rewards button. Guppy store: a close-up fish photo + one benefit badge ("Live arrival guarantee") + one CTA.
pee-safe.category-tiles: "Grab Best Offers" – a slider of kit tiles (Comfort Kit, Menstrual Care Kit, Safe Travels Kit, Zero Period Kit). Each tile is a ready-made bundle, not just a category, so the first click is already a bigger basket. Fish store: Starter Tank Kit, Breeder Pair + Food, Planted Nano Kit, Travel/Holiday Feeder Kit.
pee-safe.product-card: Busy but high-converting card: a badge pill on top (New Launch / Bestseller), rating + review count on the image, 4 benefit chips (Long-lasting, Waterproof…), MRP with a struck price and green % OFF pill, a yellow "Get it for ₹1,399 use code STEAL30" line and a full-width lime ADD TO CART. Guppy card: strain badge (Bestseller / Rare), chips (Male+Female pair, 1.5–2 cm, Tank-bred), price after code, one-tap add.
pee-safe.section: Product banner slider: a large lifestyle banner ("Toilet Hygiene for wherever life takes you" + Explore Collection) with a carousel of that range's product cards (Bestseller / Most Loved) on top of it. Each home section sells one range. Guppy store: one banner per strain family (Fancy guppies, Endlers, Shrimp) with its cards sliding over the photo.
pee-safe.shop-the-look: "Shop & Buy" – a carousel of short vertical UGC/creator videos, each with the product, price and its own ADD TO CART pinned under the video. Fish store: 15-second clips of each strain swimming, with an add-to-cart for that exact fish. Video shows colour and health far better than photos.
pee-safe.footer: Black footer: co-brand logo row (Pee Safe × FURR × Comfort), newsletter field, full contact block (registered office, support email, phone, bulk enquiries, hours), Shop / About us / Help columns, socials incl. WhatsApp. On mobile it stacks into one long column. Guppy store: show support hours and WhatsApp clearly, since live-animal buyers want to know someone will answer if a fish arrives stressed.
pee-safe.collection: Collection page = a hero strip ("Sus? Spray. Sit – Sanitised seat in 10 sec") then a 3-column (2 on mobile) grid of the same rich cards, with "Pack of 3" corner flags and the code price line. No filters, because the range is small. Fish store: a strain collection with a short banner and 'Pair / Trio / Group of 6' flags on cards.
pee-safe.pdp: Gallery + buy box: big product image with thumbnails, "🔥 2k+ people bought in last 7 days", title + one-line benefit, yellow "Get it for ₹349 use code STEAL30", rating + Verified + review link, MRP, loyalty credits pill, variant pills, qty stepper + ADD TO CART + black GET OFFER button. Guppy PDP: "120 hobbyists bought this strain this month" + price after code + pair/trio pills right next to Add to cart.
pee-safe.variant-selector: Simple scent pills (Lavender / Mint) sitting between a loyalty line ("Earn upto 49 Hygiene Credits on this purchase") and the qty stepper + ADD TO CART + GET OFFER buttons. On mobile an offers strip follows ("Get 5% off up to ₹30… View All Offers"). Fish store: pill per pack size (Pair / Trio / 6) with the reward points shown just above.
pee-safe.free-gift: Bundle builder step 2: after 3 paid picks the page jumps to a FREE product row (₹69 → FREE). Picking one fills the 4th tray slot, fires confetti and changes the tray to Subtotal ₹499 + CHECKOUT NOW. The free pick feels earned. Guppy store: "Pick any 3 pairs, then choose a free gift" (food sampler, net, almond leaves), with confetti when the box is complete.
pee-safe.cross-sell: "You May Also Like" compact cards (Portable Jet Spray, Toilet Seat Cover) with price, % off and ADD TO CART placed inside the buy box, above the description accordion. Fish store: "Pair it with" – guppy food, a breeder box or almond leaves inside the buy box.
pee-safe.pdp-details: Accordion stack: Description open (CAPS-labelled benefit paragraphs: Protection from UTIs, Shake spray sanitize, Travel friendly, Deodorizing, Disclaimer citing an NABL-approved lab test) + Manufacturing & Compliance, Caution, Additional Information. Guppy store: Strain details, Acclimatisation guide, Shipping & live-arrival policy, Care sheet.
pee-safe.reviews: Reviews block: big 4.5 average and 240 reviews, a 5→1 star bar chart with counts, Tap-to-review stars, sort/page-size selects, then review cards with avatar initials and dates. Fish store: show the star breakdown, and ask reviewers for a photo of the fish in their tank.
pee-safe.sticky-atc: Sticky bar on both devices: a yellow strip ("Get it at ₹349 – Flat 30% off") above a bar with MRP ₹499, qty stepper and a black Get Offer button (desktop adds Add to cart). The discounted price follows you down the long page. Guppy store: sticky "Pair ₹449 after code – Add to cart" bar.
pee-safe.bundle-builder: "Buy 3 @ ₹499" custom bundle page (/pages/comfort-bundle): top banner, "LIVE USER 4363" counter, a 2-step stepper (Step 1 pick 3 → Step 2 free product), cards with GET OFFER that turn into − 1 + steppers, and a yellow bottom tray ("Select 2 more item(s)" + slot thumbnails + subtotal). The best ready-to-copy idea for a guppy store: "Build your colony – any 3 pairs @ ₹999", with a live tray showing empty slots.
pee-safe.cart-drawer: Cart drawer: "Free Delivery above ₹399" header bar, then a 4-milestone reward tracker (₹399 free delivery → ₹699 10% cashback → ₹1099 free 2N pads → ₹1499 free tote bag) with "Add ₹50 more to unlock FREE Delivery", an auto-applied STEAL30 coupon chip with Remove, an "Offers Unlocked!" carousel of add-ons (Mini spray ₹99 + Add), a partner gift voucher, then "SAVING ₹150 · ₹349 · See details" next to a lime CHECKOUT button with UPI app icons. Guppy store: milestones like free insulated box → free food → free heater.
pee-safe.cart-page: /cart page: line item with qty stepper + delete, Discount accordion, estimated total, black CHECKOUT, then a "You may also like" grid with full product cards. Much plainer than the drawer, so the drawer does the selling. Fish store: keep the cart page simple but add the add-on grid (food, conditioner) under checkout.
pee-safe.checkout: Clicking CHECKOUT NOW on the bundle opens a GoKwik one-page checkout modal (no account needed to see it): "Extra Discount Available at Payment Step" banner, Order Summary (1 item ₹499), coupon field with "10 coupons available – View All", mobile-number login (+91) to redeem credits, PCI DSS / Secured Payments / Verified Merchant badges. Nothing was typed. Guppy store: Indian buyers expect this phone-first, COD/UPI-friendly checkout; show live-arrival guarantee text here as well.
